beschreibung: Issue #73: Porträts für die Nebenfiguren des Handelsspiels Marktplatz (5 Motive: Ausrufer, Tavernenwirtin, Abt Esel, König Löwe, Hofnarr). Stilvorlage sind die Narrenhof-Ölbildporträts.
stil: Painterly warm baroque oil portrait of a whimsical storybook animal character of a fairy-tale kingdom, in the same style as Narrenhof: warm lighting, rich textures, gentle friendly expression, humorous but dignified, bust portrait facing the viewer. Centred with space around. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
ohne: text, letters, readable numbers, watermark, border, frame, modern clothing, logos, alcohol, beer, wine, spirits, beer mugs, tankards, wine glasses, liquor bottles, beer barrels, drunkenness, tobacco, smoking pipes, smoking, cigarettes, drugs

motive.prompt: Painterly warm baroque oil portrait of a whimsical storybook animal herald, an anthropomorphic friendly badger in an ornate medieval herald tabard embroidered with a small golden pretzel emblem. He holds a brass horn with a heraldic pennant, standing on a charming cobblestone marketplace. Soft warm daylight, rich fabric textures, gentle smirk, humorous and dignified, bust portrait facing the viewer.

Painterly warm baroque oil portrait of a whimsical storybook tavern keeper, a friendly anthropomorphic motherly brown bear in a cozy medieval tavern dress and linen apron, holding a rustic earthenware pitcher of warm spiced apple juice with small cinnamon sticks. Background of a cozy timber-framed tavern 'Zum Brett & Blatt' with soft glowing lanterns and wooden shelves. Warm inviting lighting, rich textures, welcoming genial smile, dignified and humorous, bust portrait facing the viewer.

He holds a small fragrant sprig of garden lavender and thyme from the herb garden. Background of a peaceful monastery cloister with stone arches, sunny courtyard and herb beds. Kind, peaceful, wise and gentle smiling expression, dignified and humorous, bust portrait facing the viewer.

Background of a warm sunny castle throne room with gothic arched windows and soft red banners. Benevolent, wise, generous and gentle smiling expression, dignified and humorous, bust portrait facing the viewer.

Painterly warm baroque oil portrait of a whimsical storybook court jester, an anthropomorphic playful fox in a colorful two-toned jester cap with tiny golden bells and a ruffled scalloped collar. Background of an old castle stone chamber with a cozy lantern and an arched window opening to blue sky. Cheerful, witty, friendly smiling expression with a gentle wink, humorous and dignified, bust portrait facing the viewer.
